svg.text: AI Tools & Techniques, ~2005-2025 - A Buzzword Reference Map
Broader umbrella at top, more specific technique below. Color = what it's used for. "Model:" = what's actually trained inside.
The whole field, since the 1950s. Everything below is a type of AI.
No single model - many different model families, several shown below
Learns patterns from data instead of hand-coded rules - splits into three approaches below
Model: varies - fitted params, policies, or neural weights
Multi-layer neural networks - bridge to generative AI
Model: neural network weights (varies by architecture)
in a loop to take actions
audio, or video that didn't exist before
and planning - not just an output
Dashed gray boxes (AI, ML, Deep Learning, Transformers) are umbrella categories - everything nested inside is one of the three types above.
"Model:" = what's actually trained inside each box. Agents and RAG are usage patterns built on LLMs, not separate model families.
Vertical position is rough era, not a strict timeline - many of these (e.g. classical ML, LLMs) are still in active use side by side today.
